description: Term breakdowns for a company segment. Free. Max 5 fields.

filter.description: Kanta DB company filter. Keys: query, domain[], industry[], employee_range[], hq_country[], hq_state[], employees_min, employees_max, revenue_min_k, revenue_max_k, founded_after (year), min_contacts. industry takes industry names case-insensitively and includes sub-industries; hq_country / hq_state accept aliases and abbreviations; employee_range takes the size bands 1-10, 11-50, 51-199, 200-499, 500-999, 1000-4999, 5000-9999, 10000-49999, 50000+, Unknown. domain matches stored values exactly.
